model.singleRelativeChannel: H_N=(U/2)n^2+u(1-cos theta) on n=-N,...,N with open, noncyclic truncation

convergence.contrast: the open integer-rotor truncation converges at fixed U and u; it does not suffer the cyclic clock penalty's p^-2 first-gap collapse

architecture.preferredEncoding: signed bounded integer registers with guarded noncyclic shifts, or native quantum rotors in the dual Leech basis
architecture.overflowRule: reject or enlarge any circuit for which K^-1 maps the declared input box outside the allocated signed output box
architecture.notEquivalentTo: a cyclic p-state clock with nearest angular labels interpreted as the physical gap

established: a numerically certified convergent fixed-strength rotor-native relative-mode surrogate and quantitative cutoff and thermal targets
boundary: The calculation is a 24-fold product of relative pendula. It does not include interwire propagation, the full velocity matrix, gauge fluctuations, a thermodynamic bulk-gap proof, or chiral-edge central-charge extraction.
